purpose: Rebuild the two draw functions of the scene pass as units for single-pass stereo (docs/subsystems/single-pass-stereo.md, src/engine/render/StereoDraw.h): NiDX9Renderer::DrawPrimitive 0x007672F0 and DrawSkinnedPrimitive 0x00767520, both mapped and held (re/functions/0x007672F0.md from the eye-pass slice, 0x00767520.md from the scene-pass slice). Each rebuild is the original 1:1 over ports (the shader interface's vtable slots, the device's draw calls, the render state's sub-object slot 1 and draw flag, the geometry / partition / record reads) - bit-identical in its port-call sequence and arguments when the EyePlan has one eye - PLUS the one documented deviation of StereoDraw.h: with a plan of two eyes the device draw(s) run a second time after eyeSwitch.Switch(1), between the first eye's draw(s) and shader slot 16, then eyeSwitch.Switch(0). Take the EyePlan and the eye-switch port as inputs of the logic; the 1:1 path must not change by their presence. Tests: every mapped branch, the two-eye flow (the call sequence with the second draw and the two switches), the refusal paths (slot 10 non-zero, null skin, zero bones, null record). The emulator gate records the original's traced calls per branch; the rebuild's port-call sequence for one eye is compared with it. The engine shapes (vtable slots, offsets) go into the <Name>.h header with static_asserts; the logic is 64-bit clean (handles as std::uint32_t).

functions.known: Mapped in slice eye-pass (held, 0 core refutations): re/functions/0x007672F0.md. 226 asm lines; thiscall(renderer; geometry, ..., record), the shader from geometry+0xBC or the default +0xA94, slots 10/11 open, per pass slots 12, 13, 15, 14, the sub-object slot-1 call, DrawIndexedPrimitive per array entry or DrawPrimitive without an index buffer, slot 16; slot 17 and the draw flag close.

map.purpose: Draws one geometry as a whole (no skin partitions) with an NiD3DShaderInterface, pass by pass. It picks the shader by RTTI-casting [a1+0xBC], or falls back to this+0xA94. It opens the pipeline (slots 10, 11), then runs each pass: slots 12, 13, 15 (buffer record), 14, then the [[this+0x8AC]+0xFF0] slot-1 call. Next come the device draws: DrawIndexedPrimitive per array entry when record+0x30 != 0, otherwise one DrawPrimitive. Slot 16 closes the pass. After the pass loop, slot 17 and [[this+0x8AC]]+0xFC(0) run once per call. It reads no clock and no global, and makes no non-stack store.
map.callingConvention: __thiscall, ECX = this (renderer, kept in EDI). Six stack arguments, callee-cleaned (RET 0x18 at 0x00767513). No meaningful return value.

claims.text: C9: The slot 15 result is not null-tested. 0x00767412 is its first dereference inside this body, but the record is passed to slot 14 first (0x007673F4/0x007673FB). Slot 14 forwards it to callees that are not mapped (0x0077A1F0 V1-V3; 0x0080FC20 for SpeedTreeBranchShader), so a null record faults at 0x00767412 or earlier inside slot 14. Where exactly is unverified.

E1: Between the slot-1 call (0x0076740E) and the draw, the body reads record fields, this+0x280, the device vtable entry (+0x148/+0x144) and [record+0x48][i] (0x00767433). Between the draw and slot 16 it runs the arithmetic and loop test (0x00767464-0x00767484) plus slot 16's argument setup (0x007674A3-0x007674C3, loads and pushes only; on the DrawPrimitive arm this is the whole window). Neither window has a call or a non-stack store.
E2: Slot 16 (0x007674C5) runs once per pass. Slot 17 (0x007674F8) and [[this+0x8AC]]+0xFC(0) (0x0076750C) run once per call, after the pass loop exits at 0x007674D2. What they do is unverified.

E3: Slot 13 (0x007C9230) reads renderer+0x980/+0x9C0; their view/projection meaning is unverified in 0x007C9230.md. It sets clip planes through device+0xDC only in passes 0x177..0x17A, and only on a cache miss: a hit at L+0x214 reuses the planes from L+0x1B4, so a second eye could get stale planes. Slot 14 (0x0077A1F0) may also carry view-dependent constants. 'SetViewport' and 'constant upload' as requirements of a second eye are unverified premises of the stereo strategy.

pseudo.c disagrees with the pushes on the argument lists of slots 11, 12, 13, 14, 16 and 17. For slot 17 (0x007674F8), pseudo.c ends with iVar11, uVar12 where the asm pushes a4, a5. The instructions win.

C14: That 0x0076B160 sets this+0x0C from [this+0x89C] around the call comes from pseudocode only. The objdump of 0x0076B26C-0x0076B272 shows only MOV [EBX+0xC],EAX with EAX from [EBP+0]. Settling it needs an instruction-level trace of 0x0076B160.

The method name DrawPrimitive is a proposal by analogy (slice-scene-pass.csv:10, 'inferred'). No independent source names 0x007672F0, and none contradicts it. The name collides with IDirect3DDevice9::DrawPrimitive, which this body calls.
